subject: FinReg Solutions — private/on-prem demo timeband coordination
messages:
From: Elena Morales <emorales@finregsolutions.com>
To: support@redwood.example.com, aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-04-01 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Private/on-prem demo for compliance use case

Hi —

We completed the self-serve sign-up and selected the Private deployment option. Our security team requires a short technical demo focused on tenant isolation, network egress controls, and audit log retention. Can someone from the Redwood team run a 45-minute session next week? Prefer late-morning slots (10am-12pm PT) or early afternoon (1pm-3pm PT).

Attaching the compliance checklist the team shared with me.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of IT Operations
FinReg Solutions
Attachment: FinReg_ComplianceChecklist.pdf (PDF)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Elena Morales <emorales@finregsolutions.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-04-01 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private/on-prem demo for compliance use case

Hi Elena —

Thanks for signing up and for the checklist — really helpful. I’m Aditya on SDR/ops and I’ll coordinate the scheduling. Quick Q: will a security engineer (Tom Hayes) and one member from infrastructure join? If yes, we’ll include our solutions engineer (Priyom) and carve the agenda so it’s technical and focused.

I have these proposed timebands next week in PT:
- Tue Apr 6, 10:30–11:15 (30–45m)
- Wed Apr 7, 11:00–11:45
- Thu Apr 8, 13:00–13:45

If none work, tell us two preferred windows and we’ll keep it tight. I’ll tentatively hold the Wednesday slot on our side.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <emorales@finregsolutions.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: Tom Hayes <thayes@finregsolutions.com>
Date: 2027-04-01 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private/on-prem demo for compliance use case

Thanks Aditya —

Tom will join. Of the times you proposed, Wed Apr 7 11:00–11:45 PT is ideal. One small ask: can we push the agenda to include a quick preface on data residency and KMS options (10 minutes), then deep-dive on tenant isolation and audit logs (30 minutes), followed by 5 minutes for next steps? Also, can you share a short checklist or the POC scope in advance?

Regards,
Elena
From: priyom_das@redwood.example.com <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>
To: Elena Morales <emorales@finregsolutions.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-04-02 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private/on-prem demo for compliance use case

Elena —

Great, Wed Apr 7 11:00–11:45 PT is locked on our side. I’m Priyom (Solutions Engineer) and I’ll run the technical portion. Attached is a short POC checklist and the proposed agenda (we’ll also send a calendar invite). Quick notes:
- We’ll demonstrate tenant isolation via our VPC model and show a sample network layout (10 mins).
- KMS options and key management patterns (5–8 mins).
- Audit logs and retained events: retention windows and export options (12–15 mins).

Attachment: Redwood_Private_POC_Checklist.pdf
Attachment: Proposed_Agenda.ics

If you want, I can add a short pre-demo survey for Tom to capture any must-see items.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <emorales@finregsolutions.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com, aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: Tom Hayes <thayes@finregsolutions.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-04-03 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private/on-prem demo for compliance use case

Thanks Priyom —

One small change: our security lead has an all-hands on Wed morning and asked if we can shift the session 30 minutes later to 11:30 PT. Is that possible on your end? If so, please update the calendar invite. If not, we can keep 11:00 and Tom will join late. Either way, we appreciate the agenda and checklist — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Elena
